meta.label: STUDENT MESSAGE: Why Docker? Decide the next step.

value.thought: The student wants to know why Docker is important for their learning path as an ML engineer. I will explain the relevance of Docker based on the job market demand and its role in ML engineering, using simple language since the student is new to university.
value.answer: Docker is important because it helps you package your ML projects so they run the same way on any computer. This makes sharing and deploying your work easier. About 41% of ML engineer job ads ask for Docker skills, and it's becoming more popular. Even though your degree doesn't cover it yet, learning Docker now will give you a big advantage when applying for jobs later.
